Usage: control [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  ci         Describe CI images and test dependencies without resolving environment values
  dev        Start selected development services [alias: start]
  prepare    Write environment files and run preparation without starting applications
  db         Generate clients or push schemas for selected development databases
  env        Write resolved development environment files
  run        Run a package script with the resolved development environment
  test:unit  Run unit tests across the Turbo workspace
  test:e2e   Run e2e suites against their service stacks in Docker
  cleanup    Remove generated development artifacts
  workspace  Create and run branch workspaces
  docker     Manage declared Docker Compose services
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <PATH>  Start root detection at this directory
      --oss          Operate on the OSS source tree in an enterprise checkout
  -h, --help         Print help
  -V, --version      Print version

Create and run branch workspaces

Usage: control workspace [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create  Create a branch worktree (paired enterprise and OSS worktrees when applicable)
  list    List branch workspaces for this repository
  remove  Remove a branch workspace worktree
  start   Start this workspace runtime and open it in VS Code [alias: connect]
  dev     Run development services in this workspace runtime
  shell   Open an interactive zsh shell in this workspace
  stop    Stop this workspace runtime and dependency services
  status  Print this workspace's identity and runtime state
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <PATH>  Start root detection at this directory
      --oss          Operate on the OSS source tree in an enterprise checkout

Run e2e suites against their service stacks in Docker

Usage: control test:e2e [OPTIONS] [FILTERS]... [-- <TEST_ARGS>...]

Arguments:
  [FILTERS]...    Test package names, stack package names, or `*` wildcards. Everything runs when omitted
  [TEST_ARGS]...  Arguments after `--` are passed to every selected suite's Vitest run (files, `-t`)

Options:
      --images <DIR>               Run services from tested image artifacts (`<name>.json`) in this directory instead of starting them from source
      --root <PATH>                Start root detection at this directory
      --oss                        Operate on the OSS source tree in an enterprise checkout
      --workspace <PATH>           Prepared workspace mounted into the runner in --images mode. Defaults to the root
      --keep                       Leave containers running after the tests finish
      --plan                       Print the resolved plan as JSON without running anything
      --concurrency <CONCURRENCY>  Maximum number of test packages Turbo runs at once
  -h, --help                       Print help
